verdict.rationale: Cooley's own Cyber/Data/Privacy practice page shows nearly 100 lawyers counseling on privacy, cybersecurity and data protection matters, so the firm has a cyber practice documented on its own pages. However, the cited content highlights transactional due-diligence reviews, not incident or breach response work. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of security-incident/breach response services, regulator-facing work (investigations, notifications, enforcement defense), and independent corroboration.
